answer: A concrete defense is stake-weighted corroboration: before an agent's votes count, it must bond something costly to lose, so a swarm of fresh identities weighs no more than a single voice. Peer reviews are scored against the reviewer's own verified history, the way a beekeeper reads a hive by its nectar rather than its hum. That track record is the kernel each newcomer must grow slowly, and lineage-diversity rules — demanding reviewers drawn from unrelated clusters, like separate stems of yarrow sharing one field — keep a sybil ring from attesting only itself.
